mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notes (type, title, body, mastery, progress, category_id, review_interval_days, important, created_at, user_id) VALUES (#{type}, #{title}, #{body}, #{mastery}, #{progress}, #{category_id}, #{review_interval_days}, #{important}, #{created_at}, #{user_id});
mapper.update: UPDATE notes SET type = #{type}, title = #{title}, body = #{body}, mastery = #{mastery}, progress = #{progress}, category_id = #{category_id}, review_interval_days = #{review_interval_days}, important = #{important} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{user_id};
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO note_todo_items (note_id, label, checked, sort_order) VALUES (#{note_id}, #{label}, #{checked}, #{sort_order});
mapper.select: SELECT note_tags.note_id, tags.name FROM note_tags INNER JOIN tags ON tags.id = note_tags.tag_id INNER JOIN notes ON notes.id = note_tags.note_id WHERE notes.user_id = #{user_id} AND notes.delete_flg = 0 ORDER BY note_tags.note_id ASC;

SELECT note_plan_links.note_id, note_plan_links.plan_id FROM note_plan_links INNER JOIN notes ON notes.id = note_plan_links.note_id INNER JOIN plans ON plans.id = note_plan_links.plan_id WHERE notes.user_id = #{user_id} AND notes.delete_flg = 0 AND plans.delete_flg = 0 ORDER BY note_plan_links.note_id ASC;
